title: Clinical and radiographic evaluation of jumping distance management using a collagen matrix in flapless immediate implant placement
authors: Kadkhodazadeh M, Amid R, Moscowchi A, Khoshkam V. Dent Med Probl. 2021 Apr-Jun;58(2):173- 178. doi: 10.17219/dmp/130057. * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Within the limitations of this study, it seems that the application of a xenogeneic collagen matrix to manage 3 -4-millimeter gaps in carefully selected cases may bring promising outcomes” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
